name: connect-source-data-load
description: What: Load the single export source PDataSourceImport from the local ModelSource PData table of the run size. Setup, not a measured run. Starts from the baseline (run connect-database-reset first); fails first when the strategy reads another table than the run size. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/databases:MasterConnectionString, connect/databases:ProfiseeDatabaseName, connect/instances:ProfiseeInstanceName, connect/machines:ApplicationServerName, connect/machines:DatabaseServerName, connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inputs.name: ModelSourceSize
inputs.description: Source data size label (1K or 1M), passed by the workload that runs this one.

inputs.name: RecordCount
inputs.description: Records to load for the run size (1000 or 1000000), passed by the workload that runs this one.

inputs.name: SourceTableName
inputs.description: Source table label of the run size (PDATA), passed by the workload that runs this one.

inline.description: What: Restore ModelSourcePDATA{{ModelSourceSize}}.bak (default backup directory of the database server) over the database in connect/databases:ModelSourceDB WITH REPLACE, so dbo.PDATA holds the run size. Disconnects that database's users first. Why: Checks or changes the database directly, where the Profisee API has no call for it or a check must be exact. Success: The SQL finishes without an error; a THROW in the script fails the step with its own message. If it fails: Read the SQL error text first; then check the database server (connect/machines:DatabaseServerName) is reachable from this box with Windows authentication and the database named in the connection exists.

What: Fail unless dbo.PDATA in connect/databases:ModelSourceDB holds {{RecordCount}} rows. Why: Checks or changes the database directly, where the Profisee API has no call for it or a check must be exact. Success: The SQL finishes without an error; a THROW in the script fails the step with its own message. If it fails: Read the SQL error text first; then check the database server (connect/machines:DatabaseServerName) is reachable from this box with Windows authentication and the database named in the connection exists.

What: Fail unless 'Strategy Source Data Load' reads {{SourceTableName}}, the table the run settings name. Why: Checks or changes the database directly, where the Profisee API has no call for it or a check must be exact. If it fails: Read the SQL error text first; then check the database server (connect/machines:DatabaseServerName) is reachable from this box with Windows authentication and the database named in the connection exists.

What: Start a batch of '{{StrategyName}}'. Why: Drives Connect (strategies, service configurations, batches) through its REST API for '{{StrategyName}}'. Success: Connect accepts the Execute call with an expected status code. If it fails: Check the Connect address (connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl) answers and the Connect API key works; 400 or 409 usually means the object already exists or the artifact does not fit this Profisee release.

What: Wait for the '{{StrategyName}}' batch to finish (polls every 30 s, up to 12 h). Why: Drives Connect (strategies, service configurations, batches) through its REST API for '{{StrategyName}}'. Success: Connect accepts the WaitForBatch call with an expected status code. If it fails: Check the Connect address (connect/urls:ConnectBaseUrl) answers and the Connect API key works; 400 or 409 usually means the object already exists or the artifact does not fit this Profisee release.
